body.description: If the MMGIS ENV 'SPICE_SCHEDULED_KERNEL_DOWNLOAD=true', then at every other midnight, MMGIS will read /Missions/spice-kernels-conf.json and re/download all the specified kernels to /spice/kernels.'body' names and 'target' names must be valid NAIF SPICE names/ids. Meta-kernels (.tm) can also be set for download by using an object instead of a string (see example below).

SUN.description: SUN - Solar position for illumination and shadow analysis

MOON.description: MOON - Lunar position for eclipse and occlusion analysis
